English: Well, if the board were to ever go down for maintenance, we do have a fail-safe in place.
What's the fail-safe?
It would fall to the three of us to take on the risk of approving or denying a manuscript. An informed, but ultimately human decision.
Thankfully, it's never come to that!
Actually, that's enough questions for now
Very well!
Have you received any good pitches lately?
Nothing comes to mind, I'm afraid the board has been a little picky lately.
There's the latest Chiselton, of course. But we haven't submitted that to the board yet.
Oh yes, it's likely sitting in our inbox as we speak!
It's safe to say we're all excited about that one!
I should probably get back to formulating my pitch.
We're eager to hear it, Herman!
Can you approve The Suburban Burden now?
Sorry, Herman, but we still believe the board knew best.
The board is clearly malfunctioning, it must have made a mistake!
It'd be irresponsible to go against that decision because of a minor technical hiccup.
GRAAAAHHH!
What happened to the board?
I'm not sure, something seems to have gummed up the works.
You didn't put any liquid in there, did you, Herman?
Of course not!
It looks like I'll be pitching directly for the time being
It would seem so. It's been a while since we had to evaluate something ourselves.
Just place your manuscript in the In-tray and let us know when you're ready.
What are you looking for in a pitch?
Ah, trying to play to your audience, are we?
Something like that.
Well, I've always been partial to an action thriller myself.
Dirk's very good at that stuff, you know?
Oh yes! He's always going toe to toe with danger.
I'm practically on the edge of my seat just thinking about it.
Just try your best, we aren't exactly expecting a Chiselton thriller from you.
I'll take that into consideration.
I think that will be all for now.
Take care, Herman.
Are you sure you can't approve The Suburban Burden?
Sorry, Hermie. If the board doesn't approve, I just can't help you.
So you can't think for yourself? You go along with whatever the board decides?
It's a medical condition, okay? My doctor calls it an ‘intuition deficiency'.
Can you approve The Suburban Burden now?
Come on, you know that pitch was rejected already.
But without the board, you can finally decide for yourself!
It's just not possible, Hermie.
Last time I trusted my gut, my stomach hurt for days!
You suffer from an intuition deficiency?
I'm a textbook case for chronic indecisiveness!
What are you going to do about it?
I haven't decided yet.
What's happening with the Herman merchandise?
Ohh, you mean the Herman Merman Merch Line?
Well, I have to say I love it, Hermie. Just love it!
Well, that's a relief.
No, I really do have to say I love it. It's a contractual obligation.
I'm afraid our target demographic is finding the doll a little...
Off-putting.
Unpleasant.
Repellant, yes.
Why are there so many Herman Dolls in your office?
The stores couldn't shift them, so I guess they got sent back.
Luckily, we made them on the cheap, so we didn't take too large a hit.
I didn't realise you could pack a doll with that much sawdust, but we made it work!
Hermie, are you really afraid of some healthy competition?
There's no need to assume the worst. We may not even have to make a choice between you!
So you wouldn't end our relationship to chase larger numbers?
Like he said, we may not even have to make a terrible, but obvious choice.
It looks like the board isn't so reliable after all!
There's always bound to be teething issues whenever new technology is adopted, I'm sure the board will be up and running in no time at all!
I suppose you'll have to use your powers of decision-making in the meantime?
Let's not get too hasty, It might not come to that!
Tell me, what would you be looking for in a pitch?
That's a pretty big question, I'm not sure if I can make that kind of decision.
It's the others you'll have to convince, they're much less receptive to the ol' Herman charm!
Between you and me, I heard a manuscript from Dirk Chiselton landed in our inbox this very morning.
It did?
That's right. So, unless you have Dirk Chiselton beat, just consider this whole thing a polite formality.
I should probably get back to formulating my pitch.
We're all rooting for you, Herman!!
I think that will be all for now.
Take care, Herman.
I'd like to requisition a vehicle, please!
Do you have a vehicle requisition authorisation form?
I don't have the form, but I have a scrappy, can-do attitude!
Mm-hmm. Even if you had the paperwork, I don't have anything to give you.
The top brass came in early, totally cleaned me out of all the good stuff.
So, Stamp was right? This whole place is getting shuttered?
Look around. They've just left the junk, and the prototypes.
And, you?
Hrm-hmm.
Do you have any gadgets to spare, for my mission?
Yeah, I've still got some left-over stock back here.
Do you know what you're looking for?
Got any poison-tipped umbrellas?
Nope, just the regular kind.
I could use a camera-clad spy pigeon or two!
All out of those, since the first lot never came back. Forgot to use homing pigeons.
A pistol, cunningly disguised as lipstick?
Had to discontinue those, haven't had them since the ‘incident'.
The incident?
Don't ask.
A set of explosive, time-delay pencils!
Yeah, we've got some of that incendiary stationary...
Great!
Can't give it to you, though. There's no way you've got the clearance to handle explosives.
What are all those pneumatic tubes for?
It's all part of the ordering system. Orders come in via these tubes, and it's up to me to fulfil those orders.
Wow! So you can send and receive objects between those pipes? And they all go to different departments?
Mm-hmm. That's the gist of it.
On second thought, I don't need anything.
Lady Unterwald. Heiress to the Wald-Bahn empire?
She walks around with a cane?
She's really old and eccentric?
Doesn't ring a bell.
You really don't know who Lady Unterwald is?
Doesn't ring a bell.
I can't believe Lady Unterwald was killed!
Mm-hmm. It's a tragedy, to be sure.
You still have no idea who she is, don't you?
Not a clue.
So, are you heading anywhere exciting?
Hmm. Just the bottom of this glass, for now.
What's that you're drinking?
It's a mimosa. A bottomless mimosa, if you must know.
A bottomless mimosa!
Mm-hmm. The bartender and I have a mutual understanding.
I drink them, and he keeps ‘em coming.
What did you say you were drinking again?
It's a mimosa. A bottomless mimosa, if you must know.
Are you just gonna sit at the bar all evening, drinking mimosas?
Yup.
Drat, that actually sounds great.
Why sit around when you could help me solve a murder!
Do you have any investigative experience?
Well, no.
Mm-hmm. I'm fine just where I am.
What kind of work are you in, Ron?
I'm an accountant. I'm in accounting.
Wow, talk about a dream job! I've always wanted to perform account analysis.
Tell me about the exciting world of accounting!
I bet you get to review a lot of financial paperwork.
Hot damn!
Tell me more about being an accountant!
I'm just here to enjoy a drink, Arthur.
Tell me more about the world of accounting!
Are we talking annual auditing? Do you have to prepare tax returns?
Ahh, I'd bet you have to review entire financial operations!
Mm-hmm. It's why I drink.
I found a hidden ledger in Lady Unterwald's quarters!
Hmm. A hidden ledger?
I suspect Bergmann's been cooking the books.
Want to have a look? I'll bet you could pore over all sorts of inconsistencies!
Well, have you confronted Bergmann over this?
Oh, right. I should probably do that.
Mm-hmm. I'll take your word for it.
Are you sure you don't want to look over this ledger?
And interrupt my bottomless mimosas? Pass.
You should probably talk to the treasurer about it.
Aren't you a little young to be running a shoe shine stand?
I dunno, aren't you a little old to be a children's entertainer?
I-I'm no such thing!
There's nothing wrong with running your own business, old man. I'm an entrepreneur!
Can you tell me when the shoe shine stand re-opens?
I'll get back to it, just as soon as I finish my break.
Right now, I've got a lot of investigating to do!
When do you finish your break?
Whenever I feel like it. That's the perk about being your own boss.
It's important to have a good work-life balance, you know.
What is that toy set you're playing with?
You don't know about the 'Dirk Chiselton Junior Detective' Kit?
Enlighten me.
Jeez, you're old.
The kit has everything Dirk uses to solve a case. It's practically flying off the shelves!
Everything?
Yeah, look at this!
There's an official badge, a lock-picking set, and it even comes with a magnifying glass!
Well, I'm something of a detective myself. Perhaps I could borrow your kit?
Nuh-uh. If you're such a big shot detective, use your own equipment!
I must admit, I arrived a little unprepared.
You didn't bring anything? What kind of detective are you?
I may not have physical tools at my disposal, but I did bring the greatest tool of all.
Which is?
A powerful, investigative mind!
Ugh. An inflated ego doesn't count, mister.
Perhaps I could trade you for the detective kit?
I'm open to the idea, but I doubt you'd have something I want.
How goes business?
Hah! With all these rich folk trying to impress each other, business is booming!
Between you and me, I like to crawl under the tables and scuff up their boots.
Is that strictly ethical?
It's called being a shrewd businesswoman.
Besides, do you think the rich give a hoot about ethics?
I guess not.
Bye!
Who are you? Are you a member of the band?
No, dummy.
Beverly Moore, stage manager and agent to the stars.
Here, take my card.
That's me!
Is this a handwritten business card?
Yeah, and I'll be needing that card back. I make them bespoke!
Perhaps your agency could represent me?
Well, let me ask you this.
Do you consider yourself to be adequately talented?
I've been called adequate on many occasions.
Hmm. Do you strive for competency, above all else?
Every day!
Is “good enough”, good enough for you?
It's all I can do!
Then let's talk!
Which of your skills could be exploited for monetary gain?
You're looking at an established author! Does that count?
Nah, everyone knows there's no money in writing.
I'm a working detective!
Okay, have you solved any big cases?
Well, this is technically my first case.
I hold a certain celebrity status!
Yeah, yeah. That's what they all say.
I'm known to be very personable!
No skills, then.
How do I get my name on the guest list?
Alright, I'll be straight with you.
Normally you'd slip me some cash, and I'd look the other way, but I can tell you aren't the cash carrying type.
If you want entry, you've gotta at least be familiar with the band.
I mean, come on! I can't just be letting any random guy through. The talent would be out for blood!
I'll have you know, I'm a huge fan of the band.
Let's do a little quiz, then!
Is there a prize?
There might be a prize, but you'd have to get all the answers right.
The nerves got to me, I'd like a rematch!
Can you check the guest list again?
Let's see...
Nope, your name's still not on here.
Sorry, I can't let you in.
Can you check the guest list again?
Sorry, you're n-
Oh, wait.
Herman Merman. It says it right here!
Why didn't you say you were on the list already?
We must have both misread it!
That's odd, I'd swear it wasn't there before!
Please go right ahead, Mr Merman.
Thank you.
Let me through, I need to speak with Jian Liu!
I'm sure you do, but rules are rules, pal!
You're not on the list, so that's that.
I'm on official business, this comes from the top!
The top, huh? And who might that be?
Drat, I'm not supposed to say.
How convenient.
Just forget I said anything.
I'll be leaving now.
See you around, pal.
Ah, I'm with the band.
You're in a band?
You're looking at the lead singer in Balboa Swing.
Woah.
What about yourself?
Wait, I still haven't told you my real job!
What's wrong with being a paper-pusher?
Being a paper-pusher isn't a bad thing, Arthur. We just move in different circles, that's all.
Aren't you supposed to be performing right now?
You're starting to sound like my stage manager.
They'll call me when I'm needed.
I'm Lady Unterwald's estate attorney!
Ah, so you're a paper-pusher?
It has its moments. Sometimes I get to use the rubber stamp!
Or at least, I was.
So you're probably out of a job now, right?
Oh no, I didn't even think of that.
You know, I'm actually in a band myself!
Really? You don't look very musical.
No, I'm not sure why I said that.
I just wanted to sound cool, I guess!
I'm a Hollywood hairdresser to the stars!
With that haircut? I don't think so.
What? What's wrong with my hair?
If you were a celebrity hairdresser, you wouldn't have to ask!
I can't tell you, that's classified, I'm afraid.
Suit yourself, mystery man.
You aren't even a little curious?
I think I'm unwittingly on an adventure?
How exciting!
No, I think I'm in real danger!
Pfft! You'll be fine.
I've been instructed to have a good time.
And you think I'm that kind of girl?
No! I mean-
Relax, I'm just messing with you.
They probably just wanted you to loosen up a bit.
What makes you think I need to loosen up?
Ah, Arthur. Relax those shoulders and let it all go, you'll thank me later.
Is that guy over there bothering you?
He's a nuisance, but nothing I can't handle.
I'll give him something to remember if he decides to get too close.
That guy over there really isn't bothering you?
Trust me. I've dealt with my fair share of greaseballs.
Any tips for having some fun around here?
There are some simple pleasures in life we can all follow.
Eat, drink, sleep, f-
Okay, I think I get it!
There's no need to be such a square, Arthur.
I take no issue with the square.
Straight angles, all sides equal. Perfectly reliable for a shape!
I guess I prefer to talk with people a little more rounded.
Do you really think I'm a square?
Well, a little spontaneity couldn't hurt, Arthur.
Maybe it's time to explore some new angles.
I think Lady Unterwald was murdered!
So I've heard.
They're trying to keep it quiet to not cause a panic, but the rumours have already started circulating.
Who'd want to hurt Lady Unterwald?
I didn't know her at all, but she got us this gig.
Wasn't she insanely wealthy? That's reason enough for some people.
Aren't you worried there's a killer among us?
The train hasn't stopped, so there's nowhere for them to run.
Whoever they are, they're trapped here with us.
How'd you like to help me solve a murder?
I'm a singer, Arthur. I'm not here to ‘whodunnit'.
You know, there's a detective aboard. Can't they help you out?
You're talking about Herman Merman. He seems to have vanished without a trace!
You mean Herman Merman? I'm pretty sure he's in hiding.
Well, I'm no sleuth, but that sounds suspicious to me.
Would you care to take a look at this note?
I'd sooner jump out this carriage window than rendezvous with that rotten egg.
Well, it certainly stinks of desperation.
Are you sure you can't accept that note?
I told you I don't want anything from that rotten egg.
It stinks of desperation.
I'm not sure what to do. Any advice?
Take a deep breath, Arthur.
Make sure you speak to everyone, you never know what might come from it!
I have to go, there's an old lady waiting for me.
Really. Well, I'm not one to judge.
I have to go, I have a case to solve.
And don't even think about cutting in line, Arthur. I have low blood sugar!
Don't worry, I already ate.
I'm beginning to feel light-headed!
Where has that infernal waiter got to?
She's just up ahead.
Keep moving through the carriages, and you'll reach her eventually.
Continue walking through the carriages, and you'll reach her eventually.
She's right up ahead.
That's us!
Of course, you're Lady Unterwald's nephews.
Auntie Unterwald put us in charge of the railway Infrastructure.
Tunnels and bridges, to be precise.
Although one of those is clearly more important than the other.
Indeed. Which do you prefer, Arthur?
I'm sorry?
What's more important. Tunnels or bridges?
Aha, I knew it!
What's more important. Tunnels or bridges?
Aha, I knew it!
What's more important. Tunnels or bridges?
Ahh, I knew you'd be a fellow tunnel-head!
Sigh, of course.
You're just jealous because you got stuck building flimsy bridges.
Excuse me, bridges are a feat of engineering!
Not the ones you make, Hagen!
Ah, so you're a fellow bridge buff!
Sigh, of course you'd side with him.
You spent half the infrastructure budget on those stupid tunnels, Gunter!
And yet they're still better than your bridges to nowhere, Hagen!
Well, those are bridge-like structures.
I think that makes you a fellow bridge buff.
No, that hardly counts, they're separate things!
Don't try to complicate things, Arthur.
Oh come now, you have to answer!
Oh yes. I believe Auntie Unterwald is to announce her successor!
Mother says she'll surely keep the estate in the family.
And who better to take over the reins than her most talented nephew?
I couldn't agree more.
Oh yes, we had all kinds of meetings with her!
She used to have so many fun sayings!
''Gunter, we need to discuss this bloated budget!''
''Hagen, we've experienced yet another cave-in!''
''Do we really need another tunnel here?''
Haha, classic auntie!
Yuck! Enemies are for poor people, Arthur.
The wealthy have adversaries.
They're a much higher class of opponent.
That's more like it, Arthur.
I assume a lot of people were jealous of her wealth.
And power!
And world-class railway empire!
Don't even get me started...
We waited all this time for a table, only for the kitchen to close!
Hopefully it opens soon. I'm getting hungry!
Hunger is one thing, but I'm absolutely starving!
Is that right? Well, I'm positively famished!
Famished? If this wasn't a restaurant, I'd smack you across the mouth!
Not if I smacked you first.
What was that?
Nothing!
I was her favourite, you know!
No, she told me I was her favourite.
Oh please. She probably just confused you for me!
I was the favourite, me!
No, me!
I already told you, It was me!
Not this again! She told me I was her favourite.
Me!
No, Me!
I'm sure she spoke highly of you both.
I already told you, It was me!
Not again! She told me I was her favourite.
I was the favourite, me!
No, me!
What did I tell you about bickering?
Me!
Me!
Oh, where's that infernal hearing horn got to?
ME!
ME!
No, Mother!
Sorry again, Mother!
